name: hexa-maps
description: Hexa Maps — Open-source interactive mapping, international highway shield intelligence, multimodal routing, and community traffic platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c amber,cyan "npm run dev -w @hexa/api" "npm run dev -w @hexa/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hexa/shared && npm run build -w @hexa/shields && npm run build -w @hexa/api && npm run build -w @hexa/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c amber,cyan "npm run start -w @hexa/api" "npm run start -w @hexa/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @hexa/shared && npm run typecheck -w @hexa/shields && npm run typecheck -w @hexa/api && npm run typecheck -w @hexa/web
